name: CAP Menorca (Relais & Châteaux)
description: Fifteen suites on a south-coast clifftop in the municipality of Alaior, each with its own private saltwater pool hidden among gardens. The grounds, some 75 acres of pine replanted with thousands of trees and shrubs, hold the Casa del Mar restaurant and a small private fleet of boats for skippered cove runs. The island's most secluded luxury: few keys, wide horizon.

practicalInfo.acceso: South coast of Alaior; the hotel provides exact directions on booking.
practicalInfo.horario: Seasonal opening: check 2026 dates on the official website.
practicalInfo.servicios: 15 suites with private pools, Casa del Mar restaurant, spa and massages, yoga, private skippered boats.
